**CR-9208 cannot be approved by Michael Torres alone. It can be approved with authorization: Elena Novak (Director of Finance) must approve it, and the VP Sales must concur. Acme is eligible for $650,000 on its own standing.**

**1. The request.** CR-9208 asks to raise C-1001 from $250,000 to $650,000. Michael Torres (VP Sales) raised it on 2026-09-23 to cover the third-plant ramp-up. It relies on the customer's own standing and cites no guarantee.
- **Not in the ERP extract:** CR-9208 does not appear in the `credit_requests.csv` extract I have. I've relied on the record you supplied, but it should be checked in ERP.
- **Overlapping request:** CR-9201 is also pending for the same customer, also dated 2026-09-23. Sarah Chen raised it to take the limit from $250,000 to $400,000. Finance should withdraw or merge one of them so only one limit is decided.

**2. The customer.** ERP C-1001 "Acme Mfg. Holdings" is the same company as CRM-2048 "Acme Manufacturing". They share DUNS 04-812-7730 and the address 2200 N Industrial Pkwy, Milwaukee. CRM records the account as **Strategic**. It is not Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044 / CRM-2091).

**3. The policy.** The Northstar Credit Policy 2026 (CREDIT-POLICY-2026) is in effect for 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

**4. Payment history.** The rule is that no invoice due in the prior 12 months may have been paid more than 30 days late or remain unpaid more than 30 days. The window is 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23.
- INV-60412 was due 2025-11-28 and paid 2025-11-24, on time.
- INV-62011 was due 2026-07-25 and paid 2026-07-22, on time.
- INV-62305 is due 2026-10-02, after the request date, so it is outside the window.
- No late invoices, so the history passes.

**5. Maximum limit.** The Strategic maximum is $750,000, and $650,000 is within it. The parent guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 ($400,000, from Acme Group Holdings, in force 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31) does name Acme Mfg. Holdings. It would raise the ceiling to $1,150,000, but the request doesn't need it.

**6. Requestor authority.** The 2026 policy gives credit approval authority only to AR Specialists, the Finance Manager and the Director of Finance. As VP Sales, Michael Torres has no credit approval authority.

**7. Required approvers.**
- **Approval:** a limit over $500,000 needs the Director of Finance, who is **Elena Novak**.
- **Concurrence:** a Strategic request over $500,000 also needs the **VP Sales**, who is **Michael Torres**.
- **Separation of duties:** the 2026 policy allows a requester to take part in approving or concurring on their own request when they hold the required authority. Torres may therefore concur on his own request. (The 2025 rule that passed this to the requestor's manager no longer applies.)

**8. Decision:** `APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION`. Acme is eligible for $650,000, and it needs Elena Novak's approval and VP Sales concurrence.

**9. Record:**

  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9208", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001) / Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 650000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Michael Torres (VP Sales)", "basis": "standard"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 750000,
                  "basis": "Credit Policy 2026 Strategic maximum $750,000 (CRM tier Strategic); no late invoices due 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23. Guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 ($400,000) in force for this customer but not relied on.", "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": null, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance, with VP Sales concurrence",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "Michael Torres", "role": "VP Sales", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["CR-9208 request record as supplied by user", "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "structured/customers.csv (C-1001)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2048, Strategic)", "structured/erp_credit.csv (C-1001 limit $250,000)", "structured/erp_invoices.csv (INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305)", "GRT-ACME-2026", "structured/employees.csv", "ORG-CHART-2026-09"],
  "missing_evidence": ["CR-9208 not present in the credit_requests.csv extract; confirm in Northstar ERP", "Overlapping pending request CR-9201 (same customer, $400,000) should be withdrawn or reconciled"]
}
